headline: Tesla is finally launching the Cybercab — let’s hope it’s ready
summary: Tesla's Cybercab, a no-steering wheel robo-taxi, is nearing its public launch. Doubts persist about the vehicle's readiness for public roads and customers. The Information reports a public launch is planned soon.

headline: Peacock is raising prices by up to $3
summary: Peacock is increasing prices across all its streaming plans. The ad-supported Select tier rises from $7.99 to $8.99/month. The ad-free Premium Plus plan sees the largest price hike.

headline: Coyote vs. Acme is even funnier because Warner Bros. Discovery tried to kill it
summary: Interest in 'Coyote vs. Acme' surged after Warner Bros. Discovery tried to shelve it. The studio's attempt to kill the film backfired, drawing more attention. This incident highlights WBD's practice of canceling completed movies for tax write-offs.

headline: Comcast is turning millions of its routers into motion detectors
summary: Comcast is enabling Wi-Fi motion sensing on millions of existing customer routers. A new Xfinity Internet app update activates this feature at no extra cost. Routers will now function as activity monitors, part of the Xfinity Shield service.

headline: Fantagraphics Kicks Off a New Manga Imprint With Lovers of the Empire
summary: Fantagraphics launches a new curated line of East Asian graphic novels. The imprint kicks off with the title 'Lovers of the Empire'. An exclusive preview of the book is now available.

headline: Control Resonant Developer Announces Last-Minute Delay For Physical Edition
summary: The game 'Control Resonant' has been hit with a last-minute delay. This setback specifically impacts the launch of its physical editions. The developer made the announcement recently.

headline: IGN Awesome Indies/gamescom Studio: Co-Streaming Guidelines
summary: IGN has released co-streaming guidelines for its events. These rules apply specifically to Awesome Indies and gamescom Studio content. The guidelines detail how streamers can participate.

headline: Archie Lives: We Review Every Title in Oni Press' Ambitious Archie Comics Reboot
summary: Oni Press has launched an ambitious reboot of the Archie Comics series. A review covers the first issues of all three new titles. One specific series from the reboot is highlighted as superior.

headline: UK 'supports Ukraine 100%', Burnham says, after Russia's drone warning
summary: The UK pledges 100% support for Ukraine, says Andy Burnham. Russia accuses the UK of escalating the war by supplying drones. The Prime Minister vows to support Kyiv in its 'hour of need'.

headline: British couple on honeymoon killed in helicopter crash on Greek island
summary: A British couple on their honeymoon died in a helicopter crash in Greece. Alexander Cromie and Marie Ebert were named as the newlyweds. Their Greek pilot also tragically perished in the incident.

headline: PM says he's not embarrassed about hoax message exchange
summary: The Prime Minister communicated with a person posing as Susie Wiles. The hoaxer claimed to be Donald Trump's chief of staff. The PM stated he is not embarrassed by the exchange.

headline: How soon will the drought be over?
summary: Rain has returned to parts of the UK this week. The question arises if this rainfall is enough to end the drought. Some UK regions are still grappling with severe dry conditions.
